ros_crepiere.text: Galette complète: buckwheat, ham, cheese and an egg. Then a crêpe with salted butter caramel, and a bowl of cider. In Brittany cider comes in a bowl. Don't ask why. It's better that way.
And kouign-amann, from Douarnenez: bread dough, butter and sugar, folded over and over. Kouign is cake, amann is butter. It is exactly what it says.
